items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: So this fellow, Lee, Jackie, he came over there while we was. And that made three of us at the table.

ctx.x: Be here three years. Three years, six the next month. And this is your first time in annual? First time, I was in trouble. First time you ever been in trouble and you got lied. Yes, got lied. Oh, yes.

Well, I got this live here. I walked in the store, had a beer garden on the side of the store, you know? And two fellows leaning up on the bar and one of them asked me why that I came from. And I told him I came from Zachary. Well, he cussed me a time or two and told me I didn't come to Zachary. I told him, yes, I did. So he cussed me again. I said, well, I wouldn't call you that. So he said, let me tell you one thing. He said, you better go back to Zachary and pick some more cut, because you want to do slicker.…
what's the names of some of the songs your grandfather played you remember the names of any of them
